data.title: Bioceres Crop Solutions Reports Fiscal Fourth Quarter and Full-Year 2026 Financial and Operating Results
data.description: Bioceres Crop Solutions Corp. (Bioceres), a pioneer in developing and selling productivity solutions to rejuvenate agricultural ecosystems and enhance crop resilience to climate change, has released its financial results for the fiscal fourth quarter concluding on June 30, 2026. The figures, in U.S. dollars and complying with International Financial Reporting Standards, demonstrate the company's progress and financial standing. Bioceres, listed on NASDAQ as BIOX, continues to lead in this essential sector.

data.title: Health Catalyst Reports Inducement Awards Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
data.description: On September 14, 2026, Health Catalyst, Inc. revealed that the Compensation Committee of the Company’s Board of Directors issued 2,747,385 restricted stock units (RSUs) to Simeon Kohl under the Health Catalyst, Inc. 2026 Employment Inducement Incentive Plan. This grant is linked to Mr. Kohl taking on the roles of Chief Executive Officer and President of the Company starting the same day. The allocation of RSUs is considered a key part of Mr. Kohl's employment agreement with Health Catalyst, Inc. as outlined under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4).

data.title: Five Star Bancorp Deepens Community Commitment with Appointment of Lydia Ramirez as Chief External Affairs Officer
data.description: Five Star Bank has introduced a new executive position aimed at enhancing its dedication to engaging with communities throughout California. The newly created role emphasizes the bank's commitment to actively listening, collaborating, and addressing the needs of various communities across the state. This strategic move reflects Five Star Bank's focus on fostering relationships and solidarity with their stakeholders, reinforcing their presence and support in California.

data.title: Ascendis Announces Planned $400 Million Share Repurchase Program
data.description: In Denmark's capital city of Copenhagen, on September 14, 2026, Ascendis Pharma A/S (Nasdaq: ASND) disclosed that its Board of Directors has approved a Share Repurchase Program. This move allows the company to buy back $400 million worth of its ordinary shares.

data.title: Ascendis to Regain Rights to TransCon® Technology in Metabolic and Cardiovascular Diseases
data.description: Ascendis will regain ownership of all TransCon technology-based products related to metabolic and cardiovascular diseases, including the monthly medication TransCon Semaglutide. As a result, they will be launching various initiatives in these areas, such as developing treatments for obesity. This move marks a significant shift in focus for Ascendis in the realm of metabolic and cardiovascular health.

data.title: Rithm Capital, GreenBarn Investment Group and FarmViewVentures Announce $56.25 Million Sale of 4075 Wilson Boulevard in Arlington, Virginia
data.description: A significant commercial real estate transaction was revealed in Arlington, Virginia, as Rithm Capital Corp., GreenBarn Investment Group, and FarmViewVentures jointly announced the successful sale of 4075 Wilson Boulevard. The 188,014-square-foot Class A office property located in Arlington’s Ballston submarket was acquired in September 2024 and has been sold for $56.25 million to Piedmont Realty Trust, Inc. This sale signifies the completion of a strategic repositioning effort carried out by the three companies during their ownership of the property.

data.title: Trade groups push for stricter stablecoin limits in Clarity Act as exceptions may harm banks and limit lending. 8 associations involved.
data.description: A total of eight trade associations have expressed concerns about exceptions for interest-like rewards, which they believe could result in the withdrawal of deposits from banks and a decrease in lending activities.

data.title: TWO Announces Intention to Voluntarily Delist and Deregister 9.375% Senior Notes due 2030 from the New York Stock Exchange
data.description: A company known as TWO has declared its plans to voluntarily remove and cancel its 9.375% Senior Notes due in 2030 from the New York Stock Exchange. This decision indicates the company's intention to delist and deregister the mentioned notes.
